meta.themes: Frontier Model GA Wave, Agentic Workplace Tools, Paid Model APIs, Algorithm Discovery Agents

news.title: OpenAI launched the GPT-5.6 family with Sol, Terra, and Luna
news.summary: OpenAI made GPT-5.6 generally available across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API as a three-tier family—flagship Sol, balanced Terra, and cost-efficient Luna—highlighting agentic coding gains and an ultra multi-agent setting.

news.title: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Work as a long-horizon workplace agent
news.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work to pull context from connected apps, produce docs, sheets, slides, and Sites, run scheduled tasks, and stay on multi-hour projects, powered by GPT-5.6 and rolling out first to Pro, Enterprise, and Edu.

news.title: GPT-5.6 became the preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot
news.summary: OpenAI and Microsoft said GPT-5.6 is rolling out as the preferred model across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Copilot Chat, and Cowork, with Microsoft also accessing the models through the OpenAI API.

news.title: Meta released Muse Spark 1.1 and opened a paid Meta Model API
news.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs shipped Muse Spark 1.1 for agentic coding, tool use, and multimodal work, and opened a U.S. public preview of its first paid Meta Model API alongside free Thinking mode in Meta AI.

news.title: Meta priced Muse Spark API access to challenge Anthropic and OpenAI
news.summary: Reuters reported Meta will charge $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens for Muse Spark 1.1, with $20 in free credits, positioning the social giant as a paid API competitor for the first time.

news.title: Google Cloud made AlphaEvolve generally available on Gemini Enterprise
news.summary: Google Cloud said AlphaEvolve, its Gemini-powered algorithm discovery and code-optimization agent, is now GA on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform after early use in logistics, semiconductors, genomics, and HPC.

news.title: OpenAI launched GPT-Live full-duplex voice models for ChatGPT
news.summary: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1 mini, full-duplex voice models that listen and speak simultaneously, delegate harder work to frontier text models, and replace Advanced Voice Mode as the default ChatGPT Voice experience.

news.title: Meta launched Muse Image and previewed Muse Video
news.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Image with agentic search and coding tools plus Content Seal watermarking across Meta AI surfaces, and previewed Muse Video with native audio for a later rollout.

news.title: GitHub Copilot added GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna
news.summary: GitHub said OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models are available in Copilot, giving developers an explicit choice between heavyweight reasoning, balanced everyday coding, and lower-cost lightweight tasks.

news.title: SpaceXAI released Grok 4.5 for coding and agentic enterprise work
news.summary: Axios reported SpaceXAI launched Grok 4.5, trained alongside Cursor, at $2/$6 per million tokens and available in Grok Build, Cursor, and the SpaceXAI console, with EU access still pending.

news.title: Artificial Analysis said GPT-5.6 Sol leads coding agents at lower cost
news.summary: Artificial Analysis reported GPT-5.6 Sol leads its Coding Agent Index at 80 while scoring near Claude Fable 5 on intelligence at roughly one-third the cost per task, and noted OpenAI’s first cache-write pricing.

news.title: Anthropic launched Reflect to help users review Claude usage patterns
news.summary: Anthropic introduced a beta Reflect dashboard for Free, Pro, and Max users with memory enabled, summarizing topics and activity plus optional quiet hours and break reminders without reusing the insights for other purposes.
